inverse_transform: exp(pred_log); no smearing or bias correction
selection: max_features=0.3 fixed by group handoff before this run; no tuning
holdout_status: Revised evaluation on the SAME previously viewed holdout; not a new blind test
run_scope: Only RF/log 0.3; Lasso and RF/price are not fitted
lasso: reused prior GroupKFold predictions, no refit
c_raw_price_status: row_id, y_true, fold and required RF config checks passed
historical_config: results/development/config_used.json retained unchanged as a historical record, not current RF settings
old_RF_results: results/audit/legacy_1over3; not included in current metrics or figures

selection.criterion: pooled out-of-fold RMSE on the 10 development folds
selection.not_used: mean of per-fold RMSE, and never the test split
selection.selected_config_is: selected on CV, so its OOF score is optimistic

c_raw_price_provenance.comparison_limit: Raw-price-selected frozen RF configuration; no separate log-target tuning; source software environments differ.
